name: MRT Kajang Line (MRT1)
summary: The 51 km first MRT line from Kwasa Damansara to Kajang, serving 31 stations (7 underground). Reported construction cost about RM21 billion. Opened in phases 2016-2017.
why_it_matters: The line that proved the MRT system works. Every later rail conversation in the valley references its cost, ridership and land-value effects.
questions_to_follow: How does ridership evolve on the original line as the network fills in around it?
location_precision: Corridor-level marker near the city centre section. Station-level coordinates pending.

sources.title: Kuala Lumpur MRT Line 1 started full operation

history.event: Phase 1 opens from Sungai Buloh to Semantan.
